title: Kaleidoscope Gallery: Exploring Ethics and Generative AI Through Art
findings: Experts interpreted AI-generated imagery for ethical theories through spiritual and religious lenses, identifying symbols like the 'Tree of Life', angels, and a 'stairway to heaven'. They also connected observed gender bias in the images (e.g., male-centered depictions of virtue) to the patriarchal histories of classical religious and philosophical traditions, specifically mentioning Buddhism, Christianity, and Confucianism.
references: Evgeni Aizenberg and Jeroen van den Hoven. 2020. Designing for human rights in AI. https://doi.org/10.1177/2053951720949566
